partners.mechanism_chain: DSG2 (HGNC:2778) —DISRUPTS→ Epithelial cell adhesion and polarity (GO:0034329); Epithelial cell adhesion and polarity (GO:0034329) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal epithelial cell adhesion (HP:0030187); PAK2 (HGNC:8564) —DISRUPTS→ Cytoskeletal regulation and cell migration (GO:0007155); Cytoskeletal regulation and cell migration (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Disrupted neural tube closure (HP:0002348); Cytoskeletal regulation and cell migration (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Exencephaly (HP:0002348). Loss-of-function mutations in DSG2 disrupt epithelial cell adhesion, leading to abnormal cell adhesion phenotypes. Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in PAK2 disrupt cytoskeletal regulation and cell migration pathways, which are critical for neural tube closure and can result in phenotypes like exencephaly. The convergence is on the shared cellular processes of adhesion and cytoskeletal integrity, crucial for both epithelial integrity and neurodevelopment.

partners.mechanism_chain: NCKAP1L (HGNC:29704) —DISRUPTS→ Regulation of actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030030); Regulation of actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030030) —LEADS_TO→ Immunodeficiency (HP:0002705); Regulation of actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030030) —LEADS_TO→ Autoinflammation (HP:0011110); DSG2 (HGNC:2703) —DISRUPTS→ Cell-cell adhesion (GO:0007155); Cell-cell adhesion (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy (HP:0033674).
